headline: Asgard Alcobev gets BSE nod to change name from Banganga Paper Industries
hook: From paper maker to alcohol producer
summary: Asgard Alcobev Limited has received official approval from the Bombay Stock Exchange to change its corporate name from Banganga Paper Industries. The renaming reflects a shift in the company's business operations and identity toward the alcoholic beverage sector. Such corporate renamings are common when smaller listed entities pivot to new industries. Retail investors should review the company's underlying fundamentals and asset quality before reacting to corporate identity shifts.
whats_next: Trading under the new name on BSE
why_it_matters: Business pivot requires fundamental review before trading.
